ledger: man's right hand and grooming tool | 00:00 right hand grips white toothbrush handle pressed against closed upper lip/chin | 00:09 hand holds tool hovering in mid-air near right cheek | moves up to comb hair at 00:02-00:04, returns to lower face at 00:05, loses contact with face at 00:06-00:09

findings.description: The head of the toothbrush presses directly into the man's closed lips and philtrum, clipping into the upper lip area without the mouth opening to receive the brush.
From 00:06 to 00:09, the man's right hand performs a small scrubbing motion as if brushing, but the tool hovers in mid-air several centimeters away from his cheek and mouth with no physical contact.
